exposure: Suspected placenta previa at 20-24 weeks' gestation
outcome: Accuracy of diagnosing placenta previa at term
Need for elective or emergency Cesarean section
cohort: 53 pregnant women with suspected placenta previa at 20-24 weeks' gestation
finding: Distinguishing between the open and closed isthmus at 20-24 weeks' gestation significantly improved the accuracy of diagnosing placenta previa at term.
mod_finding: Elective or emergency Cesarean section was required in all cases of suspected placenta previa where the isthmus was open, compared to 20.6% of cases where the isthmus was closed.
gest_age: 20-24 weeks at initial assessment, term at follow-up
